Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue Jul 14, 10:00–10:45 AM

- Wed Jul 15, 9:00–9:45 AM

Attendees from our side: Monica (Security Lead), Karthik (Solutions/pen-test scope), and myself (Customer Success). If there are additional folks on your side (legal, infra), please let me know who should be on the call.

I'll attach a short SOC 2 summary and a first-pass pen test scope for your review before we meet.

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf; PenTest_Scope_v1.docx

Hi Adam —

2:45 PM PDT on Tue Jul 14 works for us. I'll send a calendar invite for 2:45–3:30 PM PDT and include dial-in/Zoom details.

Monica/Karthik — heads up: please review the attached pen test scope and SOC 2 summary before EOD Mon so we can address any open items during the call. Karthik, can you include the recommended testing windows and whether we should expect any short maintenance impact?

I'll also attach a DPA redline (we received a couple comments from legal yesterday). Priya/Adam — feel free to circulate any additional reading or internal reviewers.

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Security & DPA walkthrough — SOC 2 + pen test scope (internal)

Internal note —

Thanks for the ping. I'll be on the call on Tue 7/14 2:45 PM PDT. Quick checklist for the meeting:
- Bring SOC 2 scoping slide (summary + last attestation date)
- Call out encryption at rest/in transit and KMS integration options
- Confirm logs retention and access for auditors (we currently retain 12 months by default)
- Pen test scope: recommend non-production test window and a brief runbook for safe testing (no load tests against production models)

Karthik, can you confirm if any customers have required a live pen test against production? If not, we will recommend a staging-based test and provide sample test cases.

Monica Patel
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

1) Can you send the SOC 2 summary PDF and the pen test scope document to security@acme-inc.com so our reviewers can start looking?
2) Would you also share the DPA redline (we'll have legal look prior to the walkthrough)?

If you can provide those by EOD Mon (Jul 13), we'll be ready for a productive session.

I'll loop in our infra engineer if needed tomorrow.

– Adam

- SOC2_summary.pdf (PDF): high-level attestation date, control categories, auditor name
